title: Leader
description: JSON Schema for a leader instance: a character bearing the elevated structural role in a swarm by aggregated recognition. Carries the swarm being led, the recognition-cell aggregate, and the terminal-witness identifier.

character.description: The character slug bearing the leader role.

leads.description: The swarm slug whose recognition aggregate confers the role.

recognized-by.description: Character slugs that have emitted a recognition cell naming this leader.

holds-terminal-witness.description: Identifier of the witness this leader is currently signed as terminal authority for.
